# 25. Reverse Nodes in k-Group

## Solution 1 (O(n))

```python
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode(object):
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.next = None

class Solution(object):
    def reverseKGroup(self, head, k):
        """
        :type head: ListNode
        :type k: int
        :rtype: ListNode
        """
        if k == 1:
            return head
        dummy = ListNode(-1)
        dummy.next = head
        p = dummy
        while p:
            p = self.reverseNextK(p, k)
        return dummy.next

    def reverseNextK(self, head, k):
        p1 = head.next
        for _ in range(k):
            if not p1:
                return None
            p1 = p1.next
        ret = head.next
        p1 = head.next
        p2 = p1.next
        for _ in range(k - 1):
            p3 = p2.next
            p2.next = p1
            p1 = p2
            p2 = p3
        head.next = p1
        ret.next = p2
        return ret
```
